next_action: Register the priority projects in the project stage after confirming the registration unit (the 24 policy pillars or the measures beneath them) from the annual plan evaluation report; register the governor's promises in the promise stage from the official 2024 election bulletin (candidate panels are image-based, so visual transcription is expected); add the assembly layer in the assembly stage; keep supplementary budgets, execution and settlement as separate states.
quality_boundary: The prefecture's top plan is the Shizuoka Prefecture Comprehensive Plan (Well-being Plan, FY2025-FY2028). This review fixes that identity, the structure of three policy divisions plus administrative management above eight policies, twenty-four policy pillars, 197 initiatives and 101 outcome indicators, and the annual evaluation governance through the plan evaluation report. It is consistent with the Phase 9 registration (985 reviewed target statements extracted from the same plan, data/reviewed/phase9/22.json). Initiatives, their amounts and their evaluation states are registered in a later project stage; the FY2026 initial budget and the FY2022-FY2024 ordinary-account settlements are registered as separate fiscal records.
